measured_by: un_deltaXX, lane proofbundle, at head 7bdfb31 plus the R8 fix
why_this_file_exists: The scanner in tests/test_membership_hashable_guard.py gained a second detector on 2026-09-14: it now measures the CONSTRUCTION of a hash container from parsed data, not only the membership test. The first sharp run found seven pre-existing sites. They are carried by name so the gate can be sharp for anything NEW without blocking every landing on day one. This is a NAMED GAP, not permission: each entry still has to be closed.
why_the_detector_was_missing: The older detector visits ast.Compare with in/not in and requires the container to be a MODULE-LEVEL name. Both conditions missed cap1.py:220, where the container is built locally and the hashing happens inside the comprehension. Measured: zero hits against the full source of cap1.py while the defect was executably reproducible. A scanner that knows a class in only one of its shapes reports green and means 'this shape is not measured'.
honest_limit: The detector matches the .get(...) idiom only. A subscript on genuinely foreign data (doc['x']) escapes it, and so does a value bound to a variable first. Narrowing to .get was itself measured: including subscripts produced a false positive at relation_statement.py:340, where the list is built in-house a few lines above. Contract: test_UNTERGRENZE_ein_index_auf_fremde_daten_entgeht_dem_detektor.
